item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Modi created a genuinely independent, politically insulated investigation track for abuse by police, military, intelligence, prisons, or party-linked actors. The best positive evidence is official reform language and a reactive NHRC action; the stronger evidence still points to weak oversight and persistent impunity.","evidence":[{"title":"Ministry of Home Affairs: Year End Review 2024","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs","date":"30 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2088945&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The Home Ministry said the new criminal laws are “justice-oriented” and “victim-centric,” highlighted mandatory forensic investigation, and rolled out e-Sakshya, Nyaya Setu, Nyaya Shruti, and e-Summon.
